description: In the wake of the Washington-controlled shutdown of access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for non-US citizens, EU regulatory bodies intensify scrutiny of foreign AI providers, proposing a new framework for 'strategic dependency review' of critical AI systems. The proposal gains traction in the European Parliament as a cross-party effort to prevent unilateral access revocation in the future, marking a shift toward treating frontier AI access as a national security issue rather than a commercial one.
